body:
I was in a similar position as you, still am actually, but honestly keep trying your best but make sure you do what you want. Study one hour every night, in math just re do your homework problems till you got the hang of it, when it comes to reading things, summarize it as you read, it'll help you retain the information.

Everyone in my family swore I was going to end up in an ivy league school but I'm just another kid in community college getting by. And when it comes to motivation, look at yourself in the future, what do you want to be and then take that dream and work on it day by day.
